## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and its scope.

## Contracts

- [ ] Public API and numerical semantics are unchanged, or an ADR is linked.
- [ ] Portable-core dependency direction remains valid.
- [ ] Backend, dtype, device, copy, gradient, and JIT behavior is explicit.
- [ ] Support-matrix and dependency claims are unchanged or updated atomically.
- [ ] Provenance and third-party licenses are recorded.

## Verification

- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make typecheck`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make docs`
- [ ] `make build`
- [ ] `make audit`

List exact commands, tool/dependency versions, totals, failures, and justified
unrun matrix entries. A skipped required job is not a pass.
